settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Models you install on this iPhone stay on this iPhone. Chats with a connected computer stay on that computer.
settings.onDevice: On this device, after you install a model
settings.updateCore: Update Toskar on that computer to 1.4 or later to see answer sources, what the assistant did, live progress, and effort.
settings.jobsKeepRunning: Closing this app does not stop a job that is already running on that computer.
settings.aboutCopy: Named after Ratatoskr, the squirrel who carries messages along the world tree. Toskar links your apps to the models on your computers and on this iPhone.
settings.resetCopy: Restore the welcome setup. Clears chats on this iPhone and forgets the connected computer.
settings.resetDeletesModels: This cannot be undone. Downloaded models will also be deleted.
settings.resetKeepsModels: This cannot be undone. Downloaded models will be kept.
settings.webLookupCopy: When a question needs current information, like weather or news, this iPhone searches the web with DuckDuckGo and reads the best page before answering. Only the search words leave the phone. Answers list their sources.
settings.memoryCopy: Say “Remember that …” in a chat and it is kept on this iPhone for future chats. Turning memory off keeps what is saved.
settings.resetCopyMemories: Restore the welcome setup. Clears chats and memories on this iPhone and forgets the connected computer.

memory.sensitive: I didn't save that because it looks like a password, key, or card number. A password manager is the safer place for those.
memory.notFound: I couldn't find a memory like that. Settings lists everything I remember.
memory.none: I don't remember anything yet. Say “Remember that …” and I'll keep it for future chats.
memory.offSaved: Memory is off, so I won't use it until you turn it back on in Settings.
memory.offList: Memory is off, so I'm not using these right now.

context.title: Context
context.nearFull: Nearly full: as the chat grows, its oldest messages are sent as a summary. Start a new chat for a fresh window.
context.summarized_one: The oldest message was sent as a summary so the conversation fits. Every message is still saved.
context.summarized_other: The {{count}} oldest messages were sent as a summary so the conversation fits. Every message is still saved.
context.omitted_one: The oldest message did not fit and was left out. Every message is still saved.
context.omitted_other: The {{count}} oldest messages did not fit and were left out. Every message is still saved.
context.empty: Send a message to see how much of this model’s memory the chat is using.
context.hint: The window is how much of the chat the model can read at once on this iPhone.

setup.title: Set it up on your computer
setup.install: Get Toskar for Mac, Windows, or Linux at toskar.ai, if it isn't on your computer yet.
setup.open: Open Toskar on the computer: the Toskar app, or http://localhost:7331 in its browser.
setup.choose: Open Computers and choose Connect a device.
setup.code: Back here, choose the computer and type the 6-digit code it shows.
